title: A Fresh Sugarcane Juice Bar For Your Wedding
description: A live sugarcane juice bar gives wedding guests a fresh, alcohol-free drink pressed in front of them. Here is how it works and how to book.

imageAlt: A glass of fresh sugarcane juice being poured
author: The CaneHouse Team
html:
Looking for something different for your wedding drinks? A live sugarcane juice bar is fresh, naturally sweet and alcohol-free, so every guest can enjoy it, from grandparents to the youngest cousins.

Why sugarcane juice suits a wedding

Sugarcane has been part of celebrations for generations. In many families, cane at a wedding stands for a sweet, plentiful life ahead – a lovely meaning to share with your guests on the day. You can read more about its story on all about cane.

It is also simply a good drink for a busy day:

  • Pressed live in front of your guests – the stall is part of the entertainment
  • Naturally sweet – all the sweetness comes from the cane itself
  • Alcohol-free – a drink everyone can share and raise in a toast
  • Refreshing on a warm afternoon, between the ceremony and the meal

Flavours your guests can choose

Alongside the classic glass, we can serve flavours such as mint, lemon & ginger, pineapple, orange, watermelon, mixed fruit and masala. Many couples pick two or three that suit the season and the menu.

How booking works

Every wedding is different, so our packages are tailored to your guest numbers, flavours, serving hours and budget. To get a quote, send us:

  1. Your wedding date and venue
  2. Roughly how many guests you expect
  3. The hours you would like us to serve
  4. Any flavours you already love

For weekends and weddings we recommend booking 4–8 weeks ahead, as summer dates go quickly.

Where we travel

We are based in Sutton and serve London and Surrey. Is your venue further away? Send us the location and we will let you know.

Ready to make your day a little sweeter? Make an enquiry or see more on our events page.
